signal: FloQast hit $200M ARR and launched an AI Agent Builder, driven by enterprise momentum

email.body1:
Casey, saw FloQast crossed $200M ARR and shipped the AI Agent Builder, with enterprise driving the momentum.

Growth at that pace usually means more in-market accounts firing intent than ops can route and reps can touch in time, and that latency quietly leaks pipeline. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for FloQast off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Casey, quick follow-up for FloQast.

As enterprise momentum builds, the bottleneck is rarely targeting, it is the lag between a signal firing and a rep acting on it. By the time outreach goes out, the window has cooled and the measurable lift is gone.

Worth 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and three things I'd change. Our best-practice patterns alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent, measurable from week one.
email.body3:
Casey, last bit of proof for FloQast.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how FloQast's reply rate likely compares to other enterprise-stage SaaS teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Casey, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If tightening signal-to-action latency isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Scaling ops past $200M ARR is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a RevOps motion like yours? I'll tailor it to FloQast either way.
